calculation.description: At each completed session, reverse the close location within that session's high-low range. Lower close-location (near the low) receives a higher signal, and the signal predicts the next completed-session close-to-close return. Zero-range sessions are excluded. No future data are used.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and stable across 2020-2022 (ICIR 0.1977), 2023-2024 (0.1701), and 2025-2026 (0.1805). Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
